label: Weighted error
definition: Existing precision-specific, reference-normalized Q-minus-Q8 local error

label: Energy concentration
definition: Mean of 100 minus normalized energy entropy; lower entropy ranks higher

label: Outlier strength
definition: Mean tensor excess kurtosis of dimension-wise mean activations

label: Activation asymmetry
definition: Mean absolute tensor skewness of dimension-wise mean activations

label: Activation spread
definition: Mean tensor standard deviation of dimension-wise mean activations

label: Mean activation size
definition: Mean absolute tensor mean; not mean absolute per-token activation
